title: Query indicators sum to the query count
statement: Let $T$ be a finite-alphabet decision tree on all $n$ coordinates, and let $x$ be an input. The sum over all coordinates of the indicator that the coordinate occurs in the query trace of $T$ on $x$ equals the length of that trace, which is the query count.
